items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: The name 'Gabe' is mentioned by the interviewer as a guess for 'Johnny Prudence', but the interviewee corrects the name to Johnny Prudence and does not mention or confirm any relationship with a person named Gabe.

ctx.x: Well, that, this is thoughts of guessing, Gabe. Johnny Prudence?
Johnny Prudence. Johnny Prudence used to play with me in the Camellia band.
